checkpoints.label: C1 · Publication/discovery
checkpoints.what: Publisher releases new trade-value data (article/chart update)

checkpoints.label: C2 · Raw collection
checkpoints.what: Pull script fetches publisher HTML → ops/watchdog/pulls/*.json

checkpoints.label: C3 · Supabase landing
checkpoints.what: Save script writes rows to Supabase (public.source_trade_values etc.)

checkpoints.label: C4 · Snapshot/manifest
checkpoints.what: import_supabase_references.py stamps Supabase → data/raw/sources/ (Supabase → repo, not reverse)

checkpoints.label: C7 · Fixture promotion
checkpoints.what: promote_comparison_section.py promotes reviewed candidate → fixture (only on genuine 'ready' verdict)

checkpoints.label: C8 · Sync/validation
checkpoints.what: Fixture synced app/ → dist/, validation gates run

checkpoints.label: C9 · Deployment/live artifact
checkpoints.what: GitHub Pages deploys dist/ (browser checks Actions API live)

checkpoints.label: C10 · Rendered production output
checkpoints.what: Live production JSON serves correct week labels and loadable comparison data (catches label/data drift the pipes miss)
